method_limit: Uniform-cap integrity is independently compared with solid-angle-selected actual triangle sections in each axial vertex interval inside the required overlap slab. Section equivalence uses 1e-5 mm Hausdorff tolerance with a perimeter-scaled area bound, equal to the primary 1e-8 m collision tolerance. Section areas use 1e-9 mm snapping; uncertainty at sub-grid boundaries remains numerical. Zero volume is not clearance, fastening confirmation or a manufacturing tolerance claim.
